# Y7 Logistics — Licensed & Bonded FMCSA Auto Transport Broker

> Y7 Logistics (Y7 Consulting Inc) is a Licensed & Bonded FMCSA freight broker
> (MC #1741537, USDOT #4427359) based in Natick, MA. We connect shippers with
> vetted, insured motor carriers for nationwide auto transport across all 50 US
> states — auction pickups (Copart, IAA, Manheim), dealer trades, port and
> export deliveries, and private vehicle relocations. Y7 is a broker, not a
> carrier: carriers haul and hold cargo insurance; Y7 arranges and oversees the
> move under a $75,000 BMC-84 surety bond. Pricing is a flat dispatch fee per
> load with the carrier's rate shown on a signed dispatch sheet — no spread, no
> hidden markup.

## Core services
- [Auto Transport Services](https://www.y7agency.com/services): Full overview of Y7's brokered auto transport for shippers, dealers, and exporters.
- [Ship My Car](https://www.y7agency.com/ship-my-car): Door-to-door car shipping for individuals relocating or buying a vehicle out of state.
- [For Dealers](https://www.y7agency.com/dealers): Volume auto transport for dealers — auction pickups, dealer trades, and consolidated invoicing.
- [For Exporters](https://www.y7agency.com/exporters): Inland delivery to US ports with gate-pass and documentation coordination for overseas buyers.
- [Car Shipping Cost](https://www.y7agency.com/car-shipping-cost): How auto transport pricing works and what drives the quote on a given lane.
- [Open Car Shipping](https://www.y7agency.com/open-car-shipping): Standard open-trailer transport — the most common and economical option.
- [Enclosed Car Shipping](https://www.y7agency.com/enclosed-car-shipping): Covered-trailer transport for luxury, classic, and high-value vehicles.
- [Salvage Car Shipping](https://www.y7agency.com/salvage-car-shipping): Transport for non-running, damaged, and salvage-title vehicles.
- [State to State Car Shipping](https://www.y7agency.com/state-to-state-car-shipping): Interstate auto transport across all 50 states.

## Auction shipping
- [Auction Car Shipping](https://www.y7agency.com/auction-car-shipping): Vehicle pickup from Copart, IAA, and Manheim auction lots nationwide.
- [Copart Shipping](https://www.y7agency.com/copart-shipping): Direct lot pickup and transport from Copart yards.
- [IAAI Transport](https://www.y7agency.com/iaai-transport): Pickup and transport of IAA (Insurance Auto Auctions) vehicles.
- [Manheim Transport](https://www.y7agency.com/manheim-transport): Dealer auction transport from Manheim locations.
- [Dealer Auto Transport](https://www.y7agency.com/dealer-auto-transport): Dealer-to-dealer trade and inventory moves.
- [Door to Port Auto Transport](https://www.y7agency.com/door-to-port-auto-transport): Auction lot or residence to US port for export.
- [Auction to Port Transport](https://www.y7agency.com/auction-to-port-transport): Auction-to-port corridor service for exporters.
- [Auction Transport Savings](https://www.y7agency.com/auction-transport-savings): How buyers cut cost and storage fees on auction pickups.
